source: Claude Code 2.1.322 binary strings: the notice rendered when the signed-in account changes under a running session on a pushed credential, and the two forms it appears in
notice: signed-in claude.ai account or organization changed on this machine — run /remote-control
notice_rest: to start a session for the current account, or /login to switch back, then /remote-control
